'''Escra Fey'lya''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Bothan/Legends|Bothan]], who was a [[Police officer/Legends|member]] of the [[Office of Peace and Security]] during the time of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].

==Biography==
Fey'lya was an [[Inspector/Legends|Inspector]] in the [[Organized Crime Division]] of the OPS. When the [[Rodian/Legends|Rodian]] [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] [[Teeloo]] was assassinated by [[Kills]], an assassin working for the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord]] [[Riboga]], Fey'lya was sent to investigate.

==Behind the scenes==
Escra shares her surname with another Bothan character, [[Borsk Fey'lya]].
